project_name: RustDesk Pro Style Remote Access Panel

core_principles: Terminal-inspired aesthetics: Precision, control, and absolute clarity.
No 'AI slop' gradients. Strict, utilitarian dark mode with high-contrast sharp accents.
Data density: Maximize screen real estate using 'Control Room' grid patterns (gap-4).
Asymmetry and strict left-alignment. Focus on hierarchy rather than centered decoration.

background.description: Deep obsidian black to ground the terminal feel.

surface.description: Flat, non-glassy surfaces for widgets and cards. 1px borders, no soft drop shadows.

primary.description: Terminal Green. Used strictly for 'Online' status, active connections, and primary CTAs.

warning.description: Signal Amber. Used for warnings, offline statuses, and critical logs.

rules: Absolutely NO Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Headings and UI text must use a technical, grotesque sans-serif.
IDs (9-digit), IPs, Logs, and metrics MUST use monospace.

families.mono: IBM Plex Mono, JetBrains Mono, monospace

details: Use dense padding: p-4 to p-6 for widgets.
Gaps: Tight grid-gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) to ensure every pixel is utilized.
Borders: Heavy use of 1px solid borders (border-neutral-800) instead of card shadows to separate content.
Radii: Minimal. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (4px) maximum. No pill-shaped elements unless specifically requested by Shadcn.

components_strategy.sidebar: Collapsible left sidebar. Dense navigation links with Phosphor icons. Active states should have a harsh left border (e.g., border-l-2 border-green-500) rather than full background highlighting.
components_strategy.topbar: Minimal. Contains Cmd+K (Command Palette) search simulation, user profile dropdown, and breadcrumbs.
components_strategy.dashboard_kpis: Mode B grid. Single metric summary cards (col-span-1) with a large mono-font number and an accompanying sparkline or icon.
components_strategy.data_tables: Flat style. border-collapse. Row hover states should slightly elevate background to bg-neutral-800. Status columns (Online/Offline) must have a pulsing 8px dot (green/amber).
components_strategy.forms_inputs: Shadcn-based but brutalist. Background transparent, strictly bordered. Focus rings must be sharp green (ring-1 ring-green-500).
components_strategy.dialogs_sheets: Use for Screen Preview (mock) and edit forms. Dark overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm). Dialog content uses bg-neutral-950 with 1px border-neutral-800.
components_strategy.address_book: Bento or Grid format grouping devices by tags. Use Badge components heavily for tags.
components_strategy.audit_logs: Terminal-like output style. Time (mono), Event Type (badge), Target (mono), User. Use Shadcn Calendar for date filtering.

rules: Minimalist and functional. No bouncy or playful animations.
Status indicators (Online): Use an infinite subtle scale/opacity pulse on the green dot (animate-pulse or custom ping).
Hover states: Instant or extremely fast transitions (duration-150).

login_background.description: Abstract minimalist data center, dark cinematic lighting, glowing amber and green fiber optic cables. Use this as a moody background for the JWT Login screen, with a dark overlay (bg-black/60).

screen_preview_mock.description: High resolution screenshot of a modern IDE/Linux terminal. Use this inside a Dialog modal to 'mock' the live screen preview of a remote session.

server_room_reference.description: Alternative modern server room image if needed for marketing/auth sides.

testing_attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, nav links, table rows, and form inputs MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='device-connect-btn').
